description: This file provides a Kotlin class implementation for a demo network data source that supplies static JSON-based data for topics and news resources, primarily for development or testing purposes within an Android app.

classes.name: DemoNiaNetworkDataSource
classes.description: A class implementing NiaNetworkDataSource that supplies static data from JSON assets for topics and news resources, aiding development and testing.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Retrieves a list of NetworkTopic objects from a JSON asset.

methods.name: getNewsResources
methods.description: Retrieves a list of NetworkNewsResource objects from a JSON asset.

methods.name: getTopicChangeList
methods.description: Returns a list of NetworkChangeList representing changes in topics.

methods.name: getNewsResourceChangeList
methods.description: Returns a list of NetworkChangeList representing changes in news resources.

methods.name: getDataFromJsonFile
methods.description: Reads JSON data from the specified asset file and deserializes it into a list of objects of type T.
